Two main routes reach 1F in these videos.

1. **Plaza → central entrance:** walk under the plaza-side canopy, go through the central door between #3 and #4 into Z4, then take the central escalator up to 2F. Seen in tInHpWVey8c.
2. **2F → escalator down → west exit:** come down an escalator, walk to the west exit lobby in Z2 (next to the convenience store at the #7 position), and leave toward a road with parked cars. Seen in kmCzb3KOQ3M, which first walks the Z1 rear restaurant corridor westward, and in mJrJ8ugxlqA, which uses a shorter path from an escalator foot that is probably at the #9 end.

kmCzb3KOQ3M 1316 s and mJrJ8ugxlqA 1078 s show the same exit lobby: the same standee ad, and a convenience store on the right as you face the doors. That lobby can serve as a cross-video tie point. tInHpWVey8c covers the same ground as the already-registered 3TLdCQCjeXE central corridor, so it can anchor registration of the others.

The tall-ceiling hall, the low-ceiling ticket office and shop strip, and the harbour walkway are all 2F in every video.
